title: What are the odds that AI will affect the election?
excerpt: Future tense unnecessary. AI is currently, right now, affecting virtually everything. Anything you see, hear, or read, whether on social media or anywhere else, is already strongly influenced, if not completely created, by AI.
content_html:
Future tense unnecessary. AI is currently, right now, affecting virtually everything. Anything you see, hear, or read, whether on social media or anywhere else, is already strongly influenced, if not completely created, by AI.

Even things that you are almost sure were made by a human still carry a seed of doubt, and that's all it takes for AI to have a massive influence.
